jobs.title: Credit & Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Are you an analytical and structured professional who enjoys working with data, credit processes and business improvements? We are looking for a Credit \& Business Analyst to join our Wholesale and Services teams in a varied role supporting credit decisions, reporting, process development and business improvements.
  
  

**Company information:**  

Renault Finance Nordic is part of Mobilize Financial Services, a financial partner of Renault, Dacia and Alpine vehicles. The company supports importers, dealers and customers with financing solutions, service products and high\-quality customer support.
  
Our team consists of 19 employees who share the same objective: to deliver professional, reliable and customer\-focused service to our dealers, partners and end customers.
  
About the role
  
We are looking for a Credit \& Business Analyst for a fixed\-term position within a split function covering Wholesale and Services. In this role, you will play an important part in supporting daily operational activities, credit\-related analyses, business reporting and continuous improvement initiatives across the company. The position combines recurring wholesale tasks with analytical assignments for the Services area, giving broad exposure to wholesale financing, risk processes, data analysis and cross\-functional development work.
  
**Work location:** The position is based in Kista. Hybrid work is applicable, with the possibility to work from home up to two days per week.
  
Your responsibilities
  
Manage recurring wholesale activities such as payments, credit limit updates, reminders, reporting and stock audit follow\-up.
  
Prepare financial analyses and gather relevant information to support credit decisions.
  
Support dealership\-related matters from both legal and AML/CFT process perspectives.
  
Deliver data analysis and business reporting for the Services department.
  
Identify, analyse and develop workflow improvements across departments.
  
Support internal stakeholders with ad hoc reports, data insights and business improvement initiatives.
  
  

Who we are looking for
  
We believe you are analytical, structured and comfortable working with detailed information. You enjoy understanding data, workflows and business processes, and you have a practical problem\-solving mindset. You are motivated by varied tasks and can work effectively with colleagues, dealerships, carmakers and other internal and external stakeholders.
  
Qualifications and experience
  
Fluency in Swedish or English.
  
Strong Excel skills, including VBA and Power Query.
  
Experience with financial analysis, risk management or credit\-related processes.
  
Experience in data analysis, reporting and business follow\-up.
  
Knowledge of or interest in the automotive, financing or banking environment.
  
  

What we offer
  
You will join a varied role in an international automotive finance environment, where you will work close to the broad business and the opportunity to contribute to both operational excellence and continuous improvement. You will collaborate with colleagues across functions and have the opportunity to develop business. The position combines recurring responsibilities with analytical, reporting assignments and improvement projects, making it well suited for someone who enjoys variety and process improvement through cross\-functional collaboration.
  
Application
  
Please submit your application by 28th of September. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as reviews will be held on an ongoing basis. For questions about the position, please contact:
  
Patrik.ostrand@mobilize\-fs.com
  
  

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Business Performance Analyst
jobs.description:
We are looking for a **Business Performance Analyst** to join Packaging Solutions’ Business Unit Northern Europe Controlling team.


This role is part of our ambition to build a modern, AI\-enabled analytics capability where data, automation, and business insight drive better decisions and stronger profitability.


Hybrid role, with location in Jönköping, Stockholm, Lahti, Helsinki, or Riga.


**Your role**

As a **Business Performance Analyst** , you help transform data, analytics, AI, and automation opportunities into tangible business value.


You work at the intersection of business, finance, analytics, and technology. Your focus is not only on analysing data but on understanding business challenges, identifying opportunities for improvement, and enabling better decision\-making through data\-driven insights.


Success in this role comes from your ability to challenge assumptions, connect the dots across functions, and translate emerging technologies into practical solutions that improve business performance.


The role reports to the Head of Controlling, BU Northern Europe, Packaging Solutions.


**Key responsibilities**

* Analyze financial and business data to identify trends, drivers, risks, and improvement opportunities
* Support business stakeholders and controllers with profitability analysis, scenario modelling, and decision\-making
* Proactively identify opportunities where AI, automation, and digital tools can improve efficiency, business performance, and insight generation
* Explore external best practices, new technologies, and emerging solutions, and translate them into practical business applications
* Act as a bridge between business needs and technical solutions, ensuring initiatives create measurable value
* Collaborate with IT and data teams to design and continuously improve datasets, analytical models, and reporting capabilities
* Build, maintain, and improve dashboards, reporting, and decision\-support tools
* Ensure data quality, consistency, and a reliable single source of truth across analyses and reporting
* Combine and structure data from multiple systems and sources to support business insights
* Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders across the organisation
* Challenge existing ways of working and drive continuous improvement through data, analytics, and automation

**What you bring**

* Relevant academic background in finance, business, economics, engineering, analytics, or a related field
* Experience in business analysis, finance, controlling, commercial analysis, performance management, analytics, or a similar field
* Strong interest and experience in leveraging AI, AI Agents, automation, and modern technologies to solve business problems
* Experience with Power BI, Excel, and data analysis tools
* Familiarity with SQL and Python is beneficial,
* Business understanding and problem\-solving capabilities
* Ability to translate business challenges into analytical approaches and actionable recommendations
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
* Curiosity to challenge numbers, ask "why", and identify opportunities for improvement
* Structured, proactive, and collaborative way of working
* Fluency in English

**What we offer**

You will be part of our diverse working culture which supports you in exploring new perspectives and developing professionally. You will contribute to a more sustainable world, as we believe that anything made from fossil\-based materials today can be made from a tree tomorrow. Sustainability and innovation are at the core of our strategy. To keep you going safely, we support your physical and mental wellbeing.


**How can you apply for this role?**

You can only submit your application via our recruitment tool. We hope to hear from you as soon as possible, but no later than 29, September, 2026 and please send your application in English. Depending on the role, we might invite you to a video interview and/or aptitude tests.


If you have questions about the position, please contact the hiring manager Sami Muhonen, sami.muhonen@storaenso.com and questions about the recruitment process can be directed to our Talent Acquisition Partner Veera Kaislasalo at veera.kaislasalo@storaenso.com.


**Welcome to the The renewable materials company!**

Stora Enso is a global leader in renewable materials with a strong focus on packaging. Our purpose is to replace non\-renewable materials with renewable solutions. Together with our customers, we design and deliver competitive, high\-quality packaging materials and solutions, made from fresh and recycled fibers, accelerating the transition to a circular bioeconomy. Stora Enso has approximately 19,000 employees and our sales in 2025 were EUR 9\.3 billion.


We believe that diversity strengthens our competitiveness and leads to better decision‑making. Diverse teams with different backgrounds help us explore new perspectives and challenge our ways of thinking. We actively work to increase diversity in the workplace and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Stora Enso is an equal opportunity employer that follows non‑discriminatory practices.

jobs.title: UX Designer & Business Analyst
jobs.description:
We are looking for a UX Designer and Business Analyst (level 4\) to support the design and usability evaluation of a metadata editor and its integration into a broader digital service, as part of a strategic proof\-of\-concept initiative. The assignment covers user\-centered design, hands\-on usability testing with real end users, and ensuring the solution meets strict digital accessibility standards.


You will own the UX workstream end\-to\-end \- design, testing methodology, accessibility validation, and delivery of decision support materials for the final technology recommendation \- within a standards\-driven, quality\-critical environment.

 **Requirements**  

* Minimum of 5 years of UX design experience for web\-based business systems
* Practical, hands\-on experience conducting usability testing with real end users
* Solid knowledge of accessibility requirements per WCAG 2\.1 AA and applicable digital accessibility legislation
* Fluent in Swedish and English, written and spoken

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with service/e\-service design and delivery
* Experience producing decision support materials or evaluation reports for technology selection

  

**Benefits**  

* Shape the usability and accessibility of a high\-visibility digital service initiative
* Combine hands\-on design work with direct influence on final technology decisions
* Join inventYOU, an IT staffing and consulting company with a strong presence across Stockholm and Athens, offering long\-term engagements and close support throughout your assignment

jobs.title: GTM Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.**


n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no\-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500\+ builder\-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.


Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 \- working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

* Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
* Earned 190K\+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
* Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment \- bringing us to a $5\.2bn valuation

  

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what *you* can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out \- whether you’re technical or not \- and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.


We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.


Be the first dedicated analyst behind n8n's go\-to\-market motion.


Our commercial motion has two engines running at once: a self\-serve product that thousands of developers adopt on their own, and an enterprise sales team closing the accounts that grow out of it. We've moved to usage\-based pricing, migrated to Salesforce, and built a serious data foundation. What we don't have yet is someone whose entire job is making sense of the sales side of it.


That's this role. You'll own the analytics behind pipeline, funnel conversion and GTM planning, and partner with RevOps on the forecast \- sitting inside the data team, embedded with RevOps and Sales, and in the room when the plan gets made.

**Your mission: make our sales org measurably better at forecasting, prioritising and converting**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Own pipeline analytics, support forecasting**
-----------------------------------------------

* Build the models and views that tell us where pipeline actually stands \- coverage, stage conversion, velocity, slippage.
* Support RevOps on forecasting: supply the analysis and accuracy tracking behind it, and be the person leadership trusts to explain the number when it's uncomfortable.
* Run win/loss analysis that goes past "price" and "timing" to something we can act on.

**Connect product\-led growth to sales**
----------------------------------------

* We have thousands of self\-serve users and a sales team that can only talk to a fraction of them. Your job is to work out which fraction.
* Build account and lead scoring on product usage and firmographic signal, with RevOps and the product/customer analysts.
* Sharpen PQL and MQL definitions until reps trust what lands in their queue.

**Shape how we plan**
---------------------

* Model territories, quota and capacity for annual planning \- and make the trade\-offs visible.
* Segment the base: which accounts, which motions, which segments actually pay back the effort.
* Answer the questions that decide where the next euro of GTM spend goes.

**Build foundations people trust**
----------------------------------

* Partner with Analytics Engineering on Salesforce and product data models in dbt/BigQuery.
* Standardise metric definitions so "win rate" means one thing across sales, marketing and finance.
* Ship dashboards GTM managers genuinely run their week on \- not decks that get opened once.

**Bring a point of view**
-------------------------

* Sit in pipeline reviews and planning as a peer, not a reporting function.
* Push back constructively, including on the numbers people are attached to.
* Turn analysis into crisp, written recommendations that move decisions.

**Must\-haves**
---------------

* Senior GTM analytics chops: 5\+ years in sales, revenue or GTM analytics at B2B SaaS, with real ownership of the sales funnel.
* Sales metrics fluency: pipeline coverage, stage conversion, velocity, win rate, ACV, quota attainment, ramp, ARR/NRR \- you think in these natively.
* CRM depth: experience with Salesforce (or equivalent) \- its structure, its quirks, and the hygiene problems that quietly ruin analyses.
* Forecasting experience: you've built or contributed to forecast models and know what makes them defensible \- here you'll support RevOps on the build.
* Technical toolkit: expert SQL; comfortable in a modern warehouse stack (BigQuery, dbt, Metabase/Hex or equivalent).
* Planning experience: territory, quota or capacity modelling for a real sales org.
* Business partner mindset: credible with sales leaders and reps, and able to tell a VP they're reading the data wrong.
* Opinionated and high\-agency: you spot what's worth analysing, you do it, and you arrive with a recommendation.
* Communication that lands: memos and readouts that change what people do next.

**Nice\-to\-haves**
-------------------

* PLG experience, especially the self\-serve to sales\-assisted handoff.
* Usage\-based or credit\-based pricing: you've analysed consumption revenue before.
* Scoring and propensity models: lead or account scoring, statistical or ML\-based.
* Python for analysis: pandas, statsmodels, scikit\-learn when SQL isn't enough.
* Devtool, open\-source or technical product experience.
* Wider GTM stack: Gong, Clay, enrichment and intent data, marketing attribution.
* dbt modelling: you can ship your own models rather than only file requests.

**Why join us?**
----------------

jobs.title: Junior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Are you curious about finance, technology, and risk management? Join us as a Junior Business Analyst where you'll help translate business needs into technology solutions. You'll work with trading and risk specialists, keeping both customers and the bank safe while building your expertise in an exciting field.


**What you will be doing**

You'll be part of the Regulatory Control Systems Squad, developing and maintaining systems that support risk handling and fair customer treatment across all bank trades. Working closely with developers, traders, and risk specialists, you'll bridge the gap between business requirements and technical solutions, ensuring regulatory compliance and customer satisfaction.


* Analyse how different financial products and trades should be handled by IT systems
* Engage with traders and stakeholders to understand issues and develop solutions
* Investigate data, system behaviour and exceptions to identify improvement opportunities
* Translate business requirements into clear specifications for developers
* Help test and validate new functionality to ensure quality delivery

**About you**

* University degree in finance, economics, engineering, mathematics, computer science or analytical field
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities
* Good communication skills with interest in working across business and IT
* Curiosity about financial markets and technology
* Eagerness to learn and develop new skills

Experience with finance, SQL, risk management, or AI utilisation would be advantageous but is not required. We welcome candidates who are ready to grow their expertise with us.


**What we offer you**

You'll join a supportive team of experienced colleagues in an engaging workplace where learning is encouraged. We offer opportunities to develop expertise across banking areas and data analytics, with clear pathways for career progression. You'll work in a hybrid environment with 3 to 4 days per week in the office to promote collaboration and knowledge sharing.


**Are you ready for the next step?**

We're excited to hear from candidates who are ready to start their journey in business analysis within financial services. For questions about the role, contact Helena Persson at heper@danskebank.dk or Leif Dydensborg at ledy@danskebank.dk . Please submit your application by 30 September 2026\. We look forward to hearing from you!


We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
